newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle market at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle market at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Confirmed - none.
Feedlots were current following the second largest one day volume on record of over 83,000 head.
Asking prices Thursday were $65.00-$66.00 per cwt, with bids at $64.00. Last sales Wednesday were at $65.00.
Sales confirmed for the week to date on 125,000 head including 39,000 head or about 31 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
